nom: Paula's Choice CLEAR Salicylic Acid Exfoliating Body Acne Spray

avis.texte: I am 27F and started using this product for a bacne breakout in early May, and it is now August. An honest review (I don’t really feel comfy posting pics, but will try to be descriptive)… I broke out badly on my back with acne mechanica last winter. I’ve always had a pimple here and there, nbd, but THIS was new. I moved from the Deep South to a much colder climate, and my skin did not like it. It dried out, and the extra layers wreaked havoc on my upper back. I broke out horribly across my upper back, neck, and shoulders. (Not to mention I lost my perpetual tan lines, maybe the most tragic of all…) In May, bracing for sleeveless season, it was at its worst so I started treating with just PanOxyl in the shower. When that didn’t work, I went with this daily regimen: 1. PanOxyl 10% foaming wash in the shower with a gentle scrub brush 2. Paula’s Choice (this product) immediately after showering and drying 3. Finish with a light lotion to moisturize (either Aveeno or CeraVe) 4. Apply the Paula’s Choice as needed during the day (after sweating outside or gym mostly) 5. Very minor lifestyle changes (changed sheets at least once weekly instead of once every two weeks, change out of dirty clothes more quickly, upped water intake, breakout was worse on right shoulder I think due to purse and gym bag straps rubbing my clothing on my skin, so carried on my elbows more) I did not see results until about two or three weeks in using this regimen. I noticed a slight decrease in new bumps alt

avis.titre: Works but too expensive for what it is..
avis.texte: The spray is not as convenient as I though it would be. I really thought it was going to be a breakthrough application for me. It gets everywhere even if you are careful, ideally you still need to rub it in and apply moisturizer, and it goes fast! Only lasted me about 2 weeks. I usually need to attack my back for 4-6 weeks to fully clear it up. The key ingredient here is salicylic acid, which works well for acne but you have to stick with it and realize it may get worse before it gets better. As the skin speeds up cell turnover, things may appear worse at first, but in the long run it's beneficial. This is simply too expensive for what it is. You can find other 2% SA spray treatments that work the same for half the price, and even cheaper if you go for gel/cream forms. You're overpaying for "premium product" that isn't that special.

avis.titre: A total game-changer for clear skin – works amazingly well!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Paula’s Choice CLEAR Exfoliating Back & Body Acne Spray, and it is truly a great product. If you’ve been looking for an effective way to keep your skin clear and smooth, this is it. Why I’m so impressed with this spray: It Really Works: I’ve seen such a positive difference since I started using it; it works great for clearing up stubborn spots. Effective Formula: The 2% BHA Salicylic Acid is powerful but effective, targeting breakouts exactly where you need it. Easy Application: The spray design makes it so simple to reach those difficult areas on your back and body. High-Quality Results: It’s a reliable, high-performance product that has quickly become a must-have in my daily routine. I couldn't be happier with the results—it's an easy 5-star recommendation for anyone wanting clearer skin!

avis.titre: It works, just go for it if you are thinking about it.
avis.texte: 4 stars just because of the bottle and sprayer. This product seems to work pretty well. I use it on many parts of my body but it has tackled my problem areas being my arms and butt. I do use this after a specific body wash that also combats acne but this gives a nice soothing and clean feeling. Plus its not something you wash off so I feel it works better in conjunction with an acne body wash like from Geologie. Once the bottle is about half used, the sprayer really starts to suck. Not a huge deal, but you go from effortless application to just pumping and shaking to get the sprayer to work. I do find overall spraying the product on your hands and then applying whereever tends to be easiest and less product waste since its not spraying all over the floor and missing skin. This does have a smell; I would not say its bad but it does smell like an acne product - easily combated with scented anything. No burning or really any negative sensation from this nor any bleaching type affect either. I would recommend to those who struggle with body acne.

avis.titre: It works, and it worked faster than I thought it would
avis.texte: So I bought this just over a week ago and I wish that I had taken before and after photos. My back was never like horrible with acne, but I have my fair share of scars and I was dealing with a whole body break out. My back, thighs, and buttocks were covered in itchy, new spots where the acne just kept showing up. I’m not sure what caused the breakout, but I needed something to help fast because there’s a wedding I need to go to next week. Well, I had used retinol from Paula’s choice before and that helped with glass skin on my face. I decided they were a trusted brand and bought this. What a difference. It doesn’t completely stop the new ones coming in but it makes them small and disappear quickly. My scars are a little lighter, and the acne that had been developing before purchase is now GONE. It worked so quickly that I didn’t have time to take a picture of the breakout I was having and now just have to deal with a smooth back!

avis.titre: NO MORE BREAKOUTS... but will dry out your skin
avis.texte: I absolutely love this! Even though I am in my late 30's I have hormonal acne, and my back is prone to breaking out around my cycle and after working out. Every morning, I spray this on my back & then on a cotton round to apply to my face and allow to air dry. I only do once a day on my face as it can be very drying, but I will spray my back again after showering after a workout. I have combination/oily skin have noticed some dry patches on my face after using but extremely minimal, and only in the colder months. I wouldn't recommend using if you have dry skin. I had HORRIBLE cystic acne on my back that was painful and horrendous to look at. My dermatologist did prescribe me some wipes that helped greatly with the initial clear up but can be hard for my pharmacy to keep in stock. The auto shipment option with this spray is fantastic and it is eligible for my HSA! I haven't had any major breakouts on my face OR back since using this consistently for the past 3 months. I maybe get 1-2 pimples on my back now, and they clear up within a couple days. Short and sweet recommendations: - do not use on your face if you have dry skin - apply lotion/moisturizer once it has completely dried down - Use a cotton round to apply to face - Only use 1x per day on face due to drying, but can use multiple times per day on back/body. Start with 1 application per day and see how your skin reacts. - Use HSA funds and auto shipment, if available!
